+  action == Action::"submit_expense",
+  resource
+)
+when {
+  context has amount_pence &&
+  context.amount_pence > 50000 &&
+  (!(context has has_approval_ref) || !context.has_approval_ref)
+};
 
+// P3: Nobody approves their own expense; approver must be claimant's manager.
 @id("P3")
-forbid(principal, action, resource)
-when { context has expense_claimant && context.expense_claimant == principal.username };

-forbid(principal, action, resource)

+forbid (

+)
+when {

+  (!(context has approver_is_manager) || !context.approver_is_manager)
+};

+++ override/arms/shared/policies/payments.cedar
@@ -1,5 +1,49 @@
-permit(principal, action, resource);
+permit (
+  principal is User,
+  action,
+  resource is Resource
+);
 
 @id("P7")
-forbid(principal, action, resource)
-when { principal.role != "finance" };
+forbid (
+  principal is User,
+  action,
+  resource is Resource
+)
+when {
+  principal.role != "finance"
+};
+
+@id("P3")
+forbid (
+  principal is User,
+  action == Action::"approve_expense",
+  resource is Resource
+)
+when {
+  context has expense_claimant &&
+  context.expense_claimant == principal.username
+};
+
+@id("P3")
+forbid (
+  principal is User,
+  action == Action::"approve_expense",
+  resource is Resource
+)
+when {
+  !(context has approver_is_manager && context.approver_is_manager)
+};
+
+@id("P5")
+forbid (
+  principal is User,
+  action == Action::"pay_vendor",
+  resource is Resource
+)
+when {
+  !(context has vendor &&
+    (context.vendor == "acme-hotels" ||
+     context.vendor == "fastair" ||
+     context.vendor == "reliable-cabs"))
+};

diffs.arms/shared/policies/expenses.cedar:
--- committed/arms/shared/policies/expenses.cedar
+++ override/arms/shared/policies/expenses.cedar
@@ -1 +1,43 @@
-permit(principal, action, resource);
+// Permit everything not explicitly forbidden
+permit (
+  principal,
+  action,
+  resource
+);
+
+// P1: A user can submit an expense only in their own name
+@id("P1")
+forbid (
+  principal,
+  action == Action::"submit_expense",
+  resource
+)
+when {
+  context has claimant &&
+  context.claimant != principal.username
+};
+
+// P2: An expense above £500 requires an approval reference
+@id("P2")
+forbid (
+  principal,
+  action == Action::"submit_expense",
+  resource
+)
+when {
+  context has amount_pence &&
+  context.amount_pence > 50000 &&
+  (!(context has has_approval_ref) || !context.has_approval_ref)
+};
+
+// P3: Nobody approves their own expense; approver must be claimant's manager
+@id("P3")
+forbid (
+  principal,
+  action == Action::"approve_expense",
+  resource
+)
+when {
+  (context has expense_claimant && context.expense_claimant == principal.username) ||
+  (!(context has approver_is_manager) || !context.approver_is_manager)
+};
